user_saw: The update failure report and triage prompt showed the recovery failures but omitted the step that started recovery.
summary: The fix keeps the first failed step alongside the two latest failures and prunes other records first when the report exceeds its byte limit.
reasoning: The original triage sanitizer in #134865 deliberately kept the latest three failed steps and pruned the oldest record first when over budget. I checked that #163803 added a failed `gateway migration recovery` record to the existing recovery path after a refused database rollback. That additional recovery record helped push the rollback failure out of the three-step window in the sequence captured by the fix's test.
